fields.label: Room
fields.description: The room the guest is offered. Its room type fills in automatically.

fields.label: Room Type
fields.description: Filled from the room. Set on its own only for a request that has no room yet.

fields.label: Rooms
fields.description: Always 1 when a room is chosen.

fields.label: Rate / Night
fields.description: Nightly rate. Typing one here overrides the tariff for the whole booking cycle.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: Room plus extra beds for this line. The booking's discount comes off the total, not the line.

fields.label: Extra Beds (Adult)
fields.description: Beds beyond Max Allowed. Filled in automatically when the party is over capacity.

fields.label: Extra Beds (Child)
fields.description: Beds beyond Max Allowed. Filled in automatically when the party is over capacity.

fields.label: Extra Bed Amount
fields.description: Extra beds x nights, at this category's bed rates.

fields.label: Gross Amount
fields.description: Same as Amount; kept so older reports that read it keep working.

fields.label: Rate Agreed Manually
fields.description: Set when someone types a rate. The tariff stops applying to this line.
